# terrakube_registry_provider (Data Source)

Looks up a provider in the private registry of a Terrakube organization by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_registry_provider" "aws" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  name            = "aws"
}

output "aws_is_mirrored" {
  value = data.terrakube_registry_provider.aws.imported
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Provider name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Provider description, null when it has none
- `id` (String) Provider ID
- `imported` (Boolean) Whether the provider is mirrored from the public registry. False on a Terrakube older than 2.30.0.
- `registry_namespace` (String) Namespace in the public registry of an imported provider, null otherwise
